content.text: {"story":{"as_a":"a user with a personal task list","i_want":"to create a new task with a validated title and due date","so_that":"my tasks are stored with the required fields and can be viewed, edited and tracked later","business_description":"Users add tasks to their personal to-do list. This story delivers the create capability: a form that collects the task fields, a POST /tasks endpoint that validates the input and stores the task in a new tasks table with all task data-model fields, and success or error feedback in the UI.","business_value":"Users can record tasks with a title, description, priority and due date, and the stored tasks give the other task stories (view, update, delete, status change, reporting) data to work on.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"A user opens the task creation form and enters a non-empty title of up to 100 characters and other valid inputs","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The backend stores exactly one new task with a unique ID and the form shows a success message"},{"given":"A user opens the task creation form and leaves the title empty","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the task, no task is stored, and the form shows an error message that names the Title field as mandatory"},{"given":"A user enters a title of 101 characters","when":"The user submits the form","then":"The backend rejects the task with an error stating that the title cannot be longer than 100 characters, and no task is stored"},{"given":"The backend has set the Creation Date of a new task to 2024-05-10","when":"The user submits a Due Date of 2024-05-09 for that task","then":"The backend rejects the task with an error stating that the Due Date cannot be earlier than the Creation Date, and no task is stored"},{"given":"The backend has set the Creation Date of a new task to 2024-05-10","when":"The user submits a Due Date of 2024-05-10 for that task","then":"The backend accepts the task"},{"given":"A create request is received with valid inputs","when":"The backend stores the new task","then":"The backend sets the Creation Date and the Last Updated Date of the task, and the Completion Date is empty"},{"given":"A new task has been stored","when":"The task is read from the database","then":"The task has the fields ID, Title, Description, Status, Priority, Creation Date, Due Date, Last Updated Date and Completion Date"},{"given":"A create request is received with a create request fails because of a database error","when":"The user submits the task creation form","then":"The form shows an error message and does not show the task as created"},{"given":"A create Open question for the team.","A Due Date equal to the Creation Date is accepted.","Whether Due Date is mandatory on create is not stated in the PRD. Open question.","Completion Date is empty on create and is set only when the task is completed (handled by the status change story).","The exact wording of the error messages is not specified; they
